title: Extreme flooding events in Project areas of Odisha during August 2026

passages.locator: Paragraph beginning “Odisha” and the Rajkanika block variety table
passages.note: The August flood update reports Swarna Sub1 (85 farmers, 10 villages, 34 ha), Hasanta Sub1 (43 farmers, 10 villages, 17.2 ha), and CR Dhan 1009 Sub1 (12 farmers, two villages, 4.8 ha).

passages.quote: the farmer led project demos are being regularly monitored
passages.note: Seed was already distributed and the project was monitoring farmer-led demonstration fields. The update gives no variety-specific harvest or survival result.
